items.title: Jackie Cain and Roy Kral interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: The interviewer mentions Jan Nadelman as the owner of the house; the interviewee does not mention knowing Jan Nadelman personally, only responding to the interviewer's narrative about the house sale.

ctx.x: Yeah it was great. Well it helped us to buy our house that we have now.

Finally the owner of the house in Riverdale came back, he was in the Foreign Service, the son of Elie Nadelman, it was Jan Nadelman, he came back and we knew that it’s time. Our tenure is up, we’re not going to be here anymore. And we started house hunting. Well we looked in Nyack, we looked in Westchester, we looked here we looked there, we were so spoiled, having this huge property and trees, and view of the river and private drive. So now we can’t find anything that we can afford.
Of course the old furniture that we’d picked up that fit in the house.
